name: Progress MS-01
about: Progress MS-01 (2015-080A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MS), launched 2015 Dec 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2015 Dec 21), held fixed
docked to A06581; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
